verdict.rationale: Otter documents automatic meeting summaries with decisions, action items and insights. Next steps are captured automatically, and summaries are customizable by meeting purpose and role. Community reports confirm a summary email arrives at the end of the meeting, but one hands-on report calls the auto-emailed outline 'absurd, inaccurate', so 'good enough to share without editing' is not established. missing for 10: independent evidence that summaries are accurate and share-ready without edits, explicit documentation of 'key points' as a structured section, and corroboration of summary quality.

support.subject: As a product manager, I get a structured summary right after each meeting — key points, decisions, and next steps — good enough to share without editing

citations.quote: Otter turns every meeting into a clear summary with decisions, action items, and insights.
Clear next steps are automatically captured and assigned from every meeting.

Otter's fully customizable, AI-powered meeting summaries automatically extract actionable insights based on meeting purpose and for different functional roles, such as sales, recruiters, project managers
